description: This file is a shell script that manages the bootstrap DNS service, including registration and deregistration of DNS entries with sysEvent daemons, and handles starting or stopping the service based on network status events.

methods.name: remove_old_registrations
methods.description: Removes DNS registrations with the remote sysEvent daemon for the specified DNS name.

methods.name: remove_local_registrations
methods.description: Removes DNS registrations from the local sysEvent daemon for the specified DNS name.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Initializes service variables and sets script file path.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Starts the bootstrap DNS service, registers DNS entries, and may create a script for DNS resolution.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the bootstrap DNS service and unregisters DNS entries.
